capture: tests/webrtc/capture/turn.pcap (gitignored), captured inside the coturn container network namespace
command: tcpdump -i any -nn -w /capture/turn.pcap 'udp or tcp port 13478 or tcp port 15349 or udp portrange 50160-50200'

stun_messages.refresh_request_0x0004_or_other: remaining STUN types in the capture

notes: The capture is taken in coturn's namespace, so every packet is either TURN control or relayed traffic. DTLS handshake/application data and relayed UDP prove the media/DataChannel path traversed the relay. Direct STUN to arbitrary servers is not visible here; that is covered by the isolation nftables test and the candidate assertions.
counting: STUN message counts; a frame can carry more than one STUN message
